name: Angler Pat

intro.text: The Eden's full of salmon. Mind, so is everywhere, according to the men who tell you about them. I've been here since the dawn. No luck. A great morning.

win: Fish for it, you'll get a nibble. You got a bite. That's a great morning.
after: I'll catch one eventually. They say the Eden's very good for salmon. They also say the stone's cursed. People say lots.
